Go urges regular health checkups

Sen. Christopher “Bong” Go, chairman of the Senate Committees on Sports and on Youth, and vice chairman of the Senate Committee on Health, urged Filipinos to prioritize their health and ensure proper medical preparedness in sporting activities following the sudden death of former PBA star Peter June “PJ” Simon while playing basketball on Nov. 20.
10 hours ago

SPORTS

LGU aid in 2027 budget ‘presidential pork’ – Ping

The Financial Assistance to Local Government Units (FALGU) is “presidential pork,” Sen. Panfilo Lacson said on Wednesday, as he urged the Senate to realign this program to instead fund P5.1 billion in deleted financing for foreign assisted projects (FAP) to avoid further foreign loan penalties.
10 hours ago

TRENDING

VP incurs P5 million debt from impeach defense, trips

Vice President Sara Duterte says she has incurred a debt of P5 million in 2025 to fund her visits to The Hague, Netherlands where her father, former president Rodrigo Duterte, has been detained, and to cover the initial cost of the defense lawyers for her impeachment.
10 hours ago

Impeachment court summons BOC official, Carpio business partner

The Senate impeachment court has subpoenaed a Bureau of Customs (BOC) official and a former co-owner of Cale88 Foods Corp. to testify on the company’s business operations and export records when proceedings on the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte resume on Dec. 1.?
10 hours ago
